mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 49 degrees with overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park and a waxing crescent moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Verona Police arrested a school bus driver on Thursday after reports of dangerous driving. In other city updates, the Common Council has been managing zoning and sign ordinance rewrites, and the city has updated local polling locations, so be sure to check your designated site before heading out to vote.

There is plenty to do with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market at the Capitol Square or catch the music series at Paddy Mac's.

On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of erratic driving behavior while transporting students; fortunately, no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor is the delightful Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
